nodes.name: Execute Wyze Script
nodes.notes:
**What**: Executes Python script on OVH server to fetch current weight and body composition reading from Wyze Scale API.

**Why**: Wyze SDK requires OAuth tokens that auto-rotate every 28 days. Server-side execution keeps credentials isolated from n8n and encapsulates token refresh inside the script (script reads .env and writes updated tokens back). Virtual env ensures clean dependency isolation from other server processes.

**Gotchas**: Token refresh is automatic on every run but only persists if script completes successfully. If server offline >28 days, tokens expire irreversibly — bootstrap-wyze-tokens.py must be run locally from a residential IP to do fresh Wyze login flow. Annual Wyze developer key rotation (developer-api-console.wyze.com) requires manual .env update but no n8n restart.

nodes.name: Parse Python Output
nodes.notes:
**What**: Validates JSON output, filters by today's date (Toronto time), deduplicates on exact measure_ts, formats measurements (lbs, %, decimals).

**Why**: Wyze may return cached readings or repeat same measurement across API calls. Date filter rejects readings from previous days. Dedup uses workflow static data (lastLoggedTs) to detect second call within same measurement. Timezone conversion required (user in Canada, Wyze timestamps UTC).

**Gotchas**: Dedup key is exact measure_ts — same weight taken at different times logs twice, but identical timestamp always deduplicates even if body composition differs. Toronto timezone comparison is date-only (ignores time), so readings 11 PM one day + 1 AM next day are treated as two different days. wyze_sdk returns weight in lbs already — code does NOT multiply by 2.20462 (common mistake).

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ Wyze Scale → Weight Tracking

**Server .env — required variables:**
```
WYZE_KEY_ID=<from Wyze developer portal>
WYZE_API_KEY=<from Wyze developer portal>
WYZE_PHONE_ID=n8n-wyze-scale-sync-01ab
WYZE_ACCESS_TOKEN=<from bootstrap-wyze-tokens.py>
WYZE_REFRESH_TOKEN=<from bootstrap-wyze-tokens.py>
GITHUB_PAT=<GitHub PAT with repo scope>
```

**How authentication works:**
get_wyze_data.py on the server calls the Wyze refresh endpoint on every run and writes updated tokens back to .env automatically. The chain never expires as long as the workflow runs at least once every 28 days.

If broken (server offline > 28 days), run bootstrap-wyze-tokens.py locally to do a fresh login from a residential IP and push new tokens.

**Annual key rotation:**
1. Generate new Key ID + API Key at developer-api-console.wyze.com
2. Update WYZE_KEY_ID and WYZE_API_KEY in server .env
3. No restart needed — script reads .env on each run

**Runs:** Daily at 10 AM, or trigger manually

nodes.name: Get File
nodes.notes:
**What**: HTTP GET to GitHub API to fetch weight-tracking.md with SHA (base64-encoded content).

**Why**: SHA is required to safely write updates; GitHub prevents race conditions via SHA comparison. GitHub Content API requires Accept header (application/vnd.github+json) and explicit API version (2022-11-28). Retry configured for network transience (5s wait, 2 attempts).

**Gotchas**: GitHub returns file content base64-encoded. Response.content field has embedded newlines every 76 chars (standard base64 line wrapping) — must strip newlines before decoding. File SHA changes after every edit and is the only value accepted in subsequent PUT.

nodes.name: Append New Info
nodes.notes:
**What**: Decodes GitHub's base64 content, appends formatted measurement row with % signs, re-encodes for upload, builds commit message.

**Why**: GitHub REST API requires file content as base64 in PUT body. Markdown table schema expects % suffix on body fat, muscle, water, and protein columns (workflow adds these). Commit message includes date and weight for audit trail.

**Gotchas**: Buffer.from() with base64 input expects newlines removed (GitHub wraps at 76 chars). Output fileContent must be base64-encoded with newlines removed (GitHub strips on ingest). % formatting is hardcoded per column position — if table schema changes, formatting logic must be updated here.

nodes.name: Mark As Logged
nodes.notes:
**What**: Persists measurement's measure_ts to workflow static data (global.lastLoggedTs) after successful GitHub commit.

**Why**: Enables dedup on next execution without querying external database. Workflow static data survives across executions and is scoped to this workflow only.

**Gotchas**: Uses workflow static data (global scope), not temporary node data. If static data is manually cleared in n8n UI, dedup window resets and next run may re-log old readings. Duplicating this workflow creates a new static data store — dedup history does not carry over.
